content: Kadaudok en Eipraam Teikan
Eipraam pil pwoudikihda emen lih torohr, me adaneki Ketura.
E ahpw naitikihong Simran, Soksan, Medan, Midian, Ispak, oh Sua.
Soksan me semen Sipa oh Dedan, oh kadaudok en Dedan iei mehn Ahsur, mehn Letus oh mehn Leum.
Nein Midian pwutak iei Epa, Eper, Anok, Apida, oh Eldaa. Irail pwukat koaros iei kadaudok en Ketura.
Eipraam kihong Aisek mehkoaros me e ahneki;
ahpw nindokon eh momourte, e kihong kisakis kei ong nah pwutak me eh pwoud teiko wiahiong. E ahpw kadaralahng seri pwukat palimese dohlasang nah pwutak Aisek.
Sipalla oh Seridi en Eipraam
Eipraam eri sipalla ni eh sounpar 175.
Nah pwutak Aisek oh Ismael nekidedi kahlepe nan pwoaren paip Makpela, nan sahpw palimesehn Mamre me kisehn sapwen Epron nein Sohar mehn Id.
Ih sahpwet me Eipraam pwainsang mehn Id ko; Eipraam oh eh pwoud ira koaros seridi wasao.
Mwurin sipallahn Eipraam, Koht ketin kupwuramwahwihala nah pwutak Aisek, me kin kousoan limwahn “Pwarer en me Ieiaso Me ketin Mahmahsanih Ie.”
Kadaudok en Ismael kan
Ismael, me Akar, lidu en Sara mehn Isipo, wiahiong Eipraam,
naineki pwutak pwukat, nin duwen irekidien ar ipwidi: Nepaiod, Kedar, Adpeel, Mipsam,
Misma, Duma, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Setur, Napis, oh Kedema.
Irail wia pahpa kahlap en kadaudok eisek riauo, oh mwararail kan ahpw kohieng pohn arail kousapw oh wasahn kousoan kan.
Ismael sounpar 137 ni eh sipalla.
Kadaudok en Ismael kan kousoanla nan sahpw me mi nanpwungen Apila oh Sur, ni palimesehn Isip nan ahl me tang kolahng Asiria. Re kin kousoan dohsang kadaudok teikan en Eipraam.
Ipwidien Seikop oh Esau
Iet duwen poadopoad en Aisek, nein Eipraam.
Aisek sounpar 40 ahnsou me e pwoudikihda Repeka, nein Petuel (mehn Aram oh Mesopodamia) oh rien Lapan serepein.
Pwehki Repeka eh sohte neitik, Aisek ahpw kapakapohng KAUN-O. KAUN-O ahpw kupwurehla eh pekipek, Repeka eri liseianda.
Ni kisin mpwero ara pisipisikenpene nan kapehde, Repeka ahpw nda, “Dahme soahng wet kak wiawihkihong ie?” Ih eri patohwan peki rehn KAUN-O en ketin kamarainih.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong,

content.text: “Tohn wehi riau me mihmi nan kapehdomw.
Ke pahn naitikihada tohn wehi riau me pahn uhpene nanpwungara.
oh me laudo pahn liduwih me tikitiko.”

content: Eri, ni eh lelehr ahnsoun eh neitik, Repeka ahpw naitikihada mpwer ehu.
Kisin pwutako me ipwidi mahso me poh weitahta, kili me wunaun; iei me irail kihongki ede Esau.
Ni rieo eh pil ipwidi, e kolokol teng keimwin nehn Esauo; iei me irail kihongki ede Seikop.
Seri ko ipwidi ni ahnsou me Aisek sounpar 60.
Esau Netikihla Pwungen eh Sohso
Eri, ni pwutak ko ara keirda, Esau wiahla soupal en kesik mahn emen, me kin perenki mihmihseli nansapw; a Seikop pwutak nennen emen me kin mihmihte ni imwe.
Aisek ahpw kesempwalkihla Esau pwehki eh kin perenki sakan mahn me Esau kin kasikihdi; a Repeka kin mwohneki Seikop.
Rahn ehu nindokon Seikop eh inihnim kene kisin sali, Esau ahpw pwurodo sang kesik nansapw, inenen men mwengehda.
E ahpw ndahng Seikop, “I inenen duhpeklahr, kihdo mahs kenei kis konomw sali weitahtahn.” (Ihme e adanekihki Edom.)
Seikop ahpw sapeng, nda, “I pahn kihwei, ma ke pahn kihong ie omw pwungen sohso.”
Esau ahpw sapeng, ketihtihki, “I nektehn mehla, dah katepehiong ie ei sohso?”
Seikop eri sapeng, nda, “Nna, kahukihla mahs me ke pahn kihdo omw sohso.” Esau eri kahula oh inoukihong Seikop pwungen eh sohso.
Seikop eri kihong kene pilawa oh selie nan dahl ehu. E ahpw tungoalehla oh kohkohla. Ih duwen Esau eh sohte mwahn kesempwalki pwungen eh sohso.

footnotes.text: ESAU: Ahd wet kohsang ni eden sahpw me adaneki Seir, sahpw me kadaudok en Esau kan kousoanla ie mwuhr, oh sisen ahd Seir ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen en Ipru me wehwehki “wunaun.”
SEIKOP: Sisen ahd wet ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen en Ipru me wehwehki “keimwin neh.”
EDOM: Sisen ahd wet ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen en Ipru me wehwehki “weitahta.”
